channel.title: Kamino Blog
channel.description: Product launches, partner stories, and deep dives from the team building onchain finance at Kamino.

item.title: xPoints are live on Kamino
item.description: Earn xPoints for what you already do on Kamino — including trading tokenized stocks through xStocks. Here’s how the program works.

item.title: How Kamino Multiply builds a leveraged position in one transaction
item.description: One tap creates a leveraged position that would otherwise take a loop of deposits, borrows, and swaps. Here is the machinery that makes it atomic.

item.title: Solstice launches its market on Kamino
item.description: Solstice brought its stablecoin suite to Kamino as an isolated market — borrow, lend, and earn against eUSX and USX in one place. Here is how it came together.

item.title: Fixed-rate borrowing is live
item.description: Lock a rate and a term when you borrow on Kamino. Instead of watching a variable rate drift, you know the exact cost before you sign.

item.title: Adding new stablecoins: how Kamino integrates Ethena and Global Dollar Network
item.description: Listing a new stablecoin is not a config change. It is a pricing problem, a risk problem, and a liquidity problem — solved in that order.

item.title: FalconX brings institutional liquidity to Kamino
item.description: One of the largest digital-asset prime brokers is now routing liquidity into Kamino markets, tightening spreads for everyone who trades and borrows.

item.title: One-tap onboarding, powered by Privy
item.description: New users can now create a self-custodial account with an email or a passkey — no seed phrase to write down — using embedded wallets from Privy.

item.title: A new standard for stablecoin yield
item.description: Yield on your stablecoins that comes from overcollateralized lending, shown in dollars, with same-day access. No emissions, no lockups.

item.title: Inside curated vaults: the Allez risk framework
item.description: A curated vault is only as good as the framework behind it. Allez publishes theirs — here is how to read it, and why a named curator matters.

item.title: Curated vaults cross $1M in interest earned
item.description: The Allez-curated lending vaults have now paid out more than $1M in interest to depositors. A note on the milestone and what it signals.
